Elle est soumise aux dispositions des articles L. 2124-2, R. 2124-2 1° et R. 2161-2 à R. 2161-5 du Code de la commande publique. 1.3 - Type et forme de contrat Les lots 1 à 5 sont des accords-cadres à bons de commande, conclus avec un montant maximum fixé pour chaque lot, en application des articles L. 2125-1 1°, R. 2162-1 à R. 2162-6, R. 2162-13 et R. 2162-14 du Code de la commande publique. Ils donnent lieu à l'émission de bons de commande. Chaque accord-cadre sera attribué à un seul opérateur économique. Le lot 6 n'est pas exécuté par bons de commande et ne donne lieu à aucun paiement de la CCI. Le titulaire se rémunère sur les recettes publicitaires qu'il facture et encaisse auprès des annonceurs, et reverse à la CCI une redevance dans les conditions fixé es au CCP. La valeur estimée du lot 6, correspondant au chiffre d'affaires publicitaire prévisionnel sur la durée maximale du contrat, est de 180 000 € HT. Le regole dovranno essere rappresentate in una matrice univoca tra linea, prerequisito, evidenza, soglia, badge, gate, recupero e percorso successivo. 8. Dimensionamento e famiglie di format 8.1 Dimensionamento della componente produttiva Per ciascuno dei cinque percorsi oggetto di produzione, l’Offerente dovrà quantificare nella Proposta didattica preliminare gli output digitali e i materiali previsti, indicando almeno quantità aggregate, durata o estensione media, livello di complessità, modalità di fruizione e dipendenze produttive. Le quantità relative a webinar, lezioni in presenza, assessment e incontri individuali indicate nei template costituiscono riferimenti di architettura didattica. L’Offerente dovrà separare chiaramente i prodotti da realizzare dagli eventi da progettare e successivamente erogare da Formaper. 8.2 Famiglie di format utilizzabili Famiglia Finalità prevalente Video didattici e microlearning Introduzione, spiegazione, dimostrazione, casi e consolidamento. ASSIGNMENT TITLE: CONSULTANCY SERVICES FOR THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE NATIONAL DIGITAL SKILLS TRAINING PROGRAMME (NDSTP)

 

The Government of Uganda, represented by the National Information Technology Authority – Uganda (NITA-U), has received financing from the World Bank towards the cost of the Uganda Digital Acceleration Project – Government Network (UDAP-GOVNET) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for Consultancy services for the implementation of the National Digital Skills Training Programme (NDSTP)

 

The con

responsibility of implementation of the National Digital Skills Training Programme (NDSTP) programme across Uganda. The assignment will equip at least 6,000 beneficiaries drawn from public servants, teachers and tutors, out-of-school youth, refugees and refugee-host communities, and persons with disabilities with the digital knowledge and practical competencies needed to access services safely and productively, pursue education and livelihood opportunities, and participate as informed digital citizens.

The duration of the assignment will be five (5) months from the date of contract signing.

The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) for the assignment can be accessed at https://www.nita.go.ug

insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. This project aims to reduce the attack surfaces of space vehicles and implement robust resiliency mechanisms that enable self-protection and rapid recovery from cyber anomalies, leveraging Cyber-Hardened Satellite Software (CHSS) technology. 3.0 Period and Place of Performance • Period of Performance: The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month Base effort, followed by three (3) 12-month Option periods, plus 3 months for final reporting (Total 51 Months). • Place of Performance: The work will be performed primarily at the contractors facilit

To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. deliverables_scope.text: VA has a requirement to purchase Autotransfusion Units to deliver patient care to its VA Medical Centers around the country. An Autotransfusion Units also known as an autologous blood recovery system, is a system that provides hospitals with an easy-to-use, reliable way to recover a patient’s own high-quality blood during medium to high blood loss procedures, including cardiac, orthopedic, trauma, transplant, vascular and OBGYN surgeries. Once recovered, the blood is washed and delivered to a product bag. The complete system is designed to be intuitive and flexible for optimal performance, supporting exceptional patient care. A single award Requirements contract will be awarded as a Brand Name or Equal in accordance with all terms, conditions, provisions, specifications, and schedule of this solicitation herein. Quotes shall contain the terms for cost/price and technical capabilities of the brand name or equal equipment. The Government reserves the right to award without discussions. The associated North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code for this procurement is 339112 – Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing, Product Service Code: 6515 Medical and Surgical Instruments, Equipment, and Supplies. This combined synopsis/solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2026-01, dated 13 March 2026. Requirement Description: VA has a requirement to purchase Autotransfusion Units to deliver patient care to its VA Medical Centers around the country. An Autotransfusion Units also known as an autologous blood recovery system, is a system that provides hospitals with an easy-to-use, reliable way to recover a patient’s own high-quality blood during medium to high blood loss procedures, including cardiac, orthopedic, trauma, transplant, vascular and OBGYN surgeries. Once recovered, the blood is washed and delivered to a product bag. The complete system is designed to be intuitive and flexible for optimal performance, supporting exceptional patient care. A single award Requirements contract will be awarded as a Brand Name or Equal in accordance with all terms, conditions, provisions, specifications, and schedule of this solicitation herein. Quotes shall contain the terms for cost/price and technical capabilities of the brand name or equal equipment. The Government reserves the right to award without discussions. The associated North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code for this procurement is 339112 – Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing, Product Service Code: 6515 Medical and Surgical Instruments, Equipment, and Supplies. The associated size standard is 800 employees. This procurement action is Unrestricted Full and Open. Projektijuhil või vähemalt ühel meeskonnaliikmel peab olema riigihanke algamisele eelneva 5 aasta jooksul omandatud kogemus infosüsteemide ärianalüüsi või teenusedisaini tööde läbiviimisel ning vähemalt ühel meeskonnaliikmel peab olema riigihanke algamisele eelneva 5 aasta jooksul omandatud kogemus minimaalse töötava toote (MVP) või prototüübi arendamisel või kasutajatestimise läbiviimisel. Üks meeskonnaliige võib katta mitut rolli. Pakkuja peab esitama iga meeskonnaliikme kohta vabas vormis CV, millest nähtub isiku haridus, töökogemus ning käesoleva hanke seisukohalt asjakohane pädevus ja kogemus. Pakkuja peab esitama lepingu täitmisse kavandatava meeskonna koosseisu, tuues meeskonnaliikmed nimeliselt välja ning kirjeldades nende rolle, tööjaotust ja vastutusalasid. Pakkuja peab põhjendama, miks kavandatud meeskond on hanke eesmärkide saavutamiseks sobiv ning kuidas meeskonnaliikmete kompetentsid täiendavad üksteist. ip_data_security.text: nboarding the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI) to the National Eye Institute’s (NEI) existing OpenSpecimen biobanking software instance and implementing associated Electronic Medical Record (EMR) integration services. Competition is restricted to Krishagni LLC because NHLBI’s requirement is specifically to onboard to NEI’s active, Krishagni-licensed and operated OpenSpecimen environment rather than to procure a separate standalone biobanking system. Acquiring a different biobanking product would not satisfy the requirement to join the existing NEI shared instance and would result in substantial duplication of software licensing, implementation, validation, and support infrastructure costs, as well as unacceptable operational delays. As the software developer, proprietor, and operator of the existing NEI OpenSpecimen environment, Krishagni LLC is the only responsible source authorized and technically capable of performing the required onboarding, workflow configuration, and EMR integration services within that shared platform. Requirements/Salient Characteristics: The following specification lists the minimum requirements for a lock-in amplifier. Objective requirements are also highlighted when available. A lock-in amplifier is crucial for separating laser photodetector outputs from noise that may otherwise drown out the signal. Therefore, this lock-in component is necessary for meeting mission requirements. 3.1. The lock-in amplifier shall meet the following technical requirements: 3.1.1. Demodulation capability for DC up to 600 megahertz or higher reference signals 3.1.2. At least two analog BNC inputs 3.1.3. At least two analog BNC outputs 3.1.4. Analog to digital input conversion capability included, along with the inverse of digital to analog output conversion 3.1.5. Minimum sampling rate for input data of 1.25 giga-samples per second (GSa/s) 3.1.6. USB 2.0 or USB-C interface is supported 3.1.7. PC software interface included 3.1.8. Coding support for either Python or MATLAB languages 3.1.8.1. API for supported language must be given 3.1.9. Come with a manufacturer’s warranty of at least 1 year 3.1.10. Signal output must support digital to analog conversion of at least 1.25 giga-s
